## Activity

During November 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 116 captures. This provides an overview of the screening activity completed at the site during the reporting month. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine operational reporting, with any material changes considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

A total of 13 captures were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 11.2. These results should be reviewed as part of the site’s routine quality monitoring. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that faults can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support process. Staff should also continue to follow established procedures for image capture and equipment checks.

## Grading

Grading identified 21 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure should be considered alongside the referable results and the ungradable activity when reviewing service performance. Continued monitoring will support identification of any emerging operational issues and help maintain timely grading and appropriate follow-up.
